about: Corrected rules text for cards whose text is mangled in the bulk data (data/lorcana-cards.raw.json) and missing or mangled in Lorcast's (data/lorcast-cards.json). Keyed by full name; bin/build_db.dart uses the text here in place of the bulk text. Each entry says where its wording comes from: nothing here is written from memory alone.

Let The Storm Rage On.text:
(A character with cost 3 or more can {e} to sing this song for free.)
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. Draw a card.
Let The Storm Rage On.source: Lorcast's text for "Let the Storm Rage On" (a different capitalization, so build_db's name lookup misses it). The bulk text says "Deal 2 damaged" and has a literal \n.

Hiro Hamada - Robotics Prodigy.text: SWEET TECH {e}, 2 {i} - Search your deck for an item card or a Robot character card and reveal it to all players. Shuffle your deck and put that card on top of it.
Hiro Hamada - Robotics Prodigy.source: Lorcast's text, "SWEET TECH {2} {E} - Search …": the bulk text has lost the ability's cost; Lorcast keeps its parts ({E} and 2 ink), written here in the usual "{e}, 2 {i}" order.
